tasks.final_text: Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business district of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.

Yesterday I went on a wonderful motorcycle ride. I went up and down the I9, rode up into the mountains and looked at deer and bears crossing the roads. At noon, I stopped near a body of water and skipped some stones for a few minutes while talking to my riding buddy. All and all it was a great day.
